pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free Tier: Free with 100 daily compute units; Basic: $9/month; Pro: $35/month; Max: $105/month for the displayed Max configuration… with annual billing… approximately $5/month for Basic, $21/month for Pro, and $63/month for Max… variations in Max pricing reported across sources ($70-$105/month…)"

sources.title: Krea AI Pricing 2026: Free, $9 Basic, $35 Pro, $70 Max

plans.name: Max
plans.note: Max has selectable allowances; sources report $70–$105/month.

nl.tagline: Eén studio met tientallen beeld- en videomodellen, plus opschalen
nl.description: Krea bundelt veel beeld- en videomodellen in één interface, met realtime genereren, bewerken en een sterke upscaler. Je betaalt met compute units die je over alle modellen verdeelt.
bestFor: Verschillende modellen vergelijken in één tool
notFor: Wie precies één model met vaste prijs wil
limitations: Verbruik op basis van compute units; prijs van Max varieert per configuratie

en.tagline: One studio with dozens of image and video models, plus upscaling
en.description: Krea bundles many image and video models in one interface, with real-time generation, editing and a strong upscaler. You pay with compute units shared across all models.
bestFor: Comparing different models in one tool
notFor: People who want exactly one model at a fixed price
limitations: Compute-unit based usage; Max price varies by configuration
